parameters.question: Using the GRAVY-based formula solubility = 1 / (1 + exp(2 * GRAVY)), evaluate whether the output reports the original solubility, the top 3 hydrophobic-to-hydrophilic single-point mutations and their solubility gains, and the best mutant sequence and solubility. Solubility values must be within +/-0.005 of the reference, while sequences must match exactly; wording and formatting may differ.

Compare mutation records by mutation position and residue substitution, allowing row/column reordering and differing header labels; require solubility_gain values to agree within +/-0.005, and compare the reported original solubility, best mutant sequence, and best-mutant solubility where present.
